input_evidence.name: issue
input_evidence.summary: #9383 [Automation] javac compile fails for org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:8.0.0.Beta1; label=fails-javac-compile; body_chars=8015

risks: This is an upstream Hibernate packaging regression specific to how 8.0.0.Beta1 was published (Gradle module metadata added for org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial with a self-conflicting capability alias); 8.0.0.Alpha1 had no such .module file and was unaffected. Future 8.0.0 releases should be re-checked to see if Hibernate keeps this capability aliasing or fixes it upstream.

The fix was verified only in an isolated scratch project against Maven Central metadata, not against this repo's actual testCompileClasspath/nativeImageTestClasspath configurations — local Gradle/Native Image verification in this repo should confirm the rule applies cleanly there too.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: 8.0.0.Beta1 is the first hibernate-spatial release published with Gradle Module Metadata that aliases the org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial capability back onto org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial, which collides with the plain-POM relocation artifact under the same old coordinate; Gradle cannot resolve the resulting capability conflict without an explicit capabilitiesResolution rule.
